---
title: "US Election PLS-SEM - Macro salience models"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Load packages

```{r}
if (!require("tidyverse")) install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)

if (!require("seminr")) install.packages("seminr")
library(seminr)

if (!require("DiagrammeRsvg")) install.packages("DiagrammeRsvg")
library(DiagrammeRsvg)

if (!require("rsvg")) install.packages("rsvg")
library(rsvg)

dir.create("macro_model_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
report_dir <- "macro_model_outputs"
```

## Load data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("sem_dataset_macro.csv")

required_cols <- c(
  "State",
  "republican_pct",
  "Governance_Democracy_salience",
  "Public_Health_salience",
  "Economy_salience",
  "Foreign_Policy_salience",
  "Immigration_salience",
  "Social_Issues_salience"
)

stopifnot(all(required_cols %in% names(df)))
df <- df[, required_cols]

numeric_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "State")
df[numeric_cols] <- lapply(df[numeric_cols], as.numeric)

summary(df)
```

## Helper functions

```{r}
save_plot <- function(model_object, filename, title_text = "") {
  p <- plot(model_object, title = title_text)
  svg_text <- DiagrammeRsvg::export_svg(p)
  svg_text <- sub("(<svg[^>]*>)",
                  "\\1\n<rect width=\"100%\" height=\"100%\" fill=\"white\"/>",
                  svg_text)
  rsvg::rsvg_png(charToRaw(svg_text),
                 file.path("macro_model_outputs", paste0(filename, ".png")),
                 width = 1400)
}

print_paths <- function(boot) {
  paths <- as.data.frame(summary(boot)$bootstrapped_paths)
  paths <- paths[!grepl("republican_pct", rownames(paths)), , drop = FALSE]
  paths[, c("Original Est.", "T Stat.", "Bootstrap P Val")]
}

save_summary <- function(boot, est, filename) {
  filepath <- file.path("macro_model_outputs", paste0(filename, ".txt"))
  sink(filepath)
  cat(filename, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n\n")
  print(summary(boot))
  cat("\n\nModel summary (estimate):\n")
  cat(paste(rep("-", 60), collapse = ""), "\n")
  print(summary(est))
  sink()
}

extract_vote_r2 <- function(model_summary) {
  if (!is.null(model_summary$r_squared) && "VOTE" %in% rownames(model_summary$r_squared)) {
    return(as.numeric(model_summary$r_squared["VOTE", "R^2"]))
  }
  NA_real_
}
```

## Measurement models

```{r}
mm_salience <- constructs(
  composite("DEMLAW", single_item("Governance_Democracy_salience")),
  composite("DOMPOL", single_item("Public_Health_salience")),
  composite("ECON",   single_item("Economy_salience")),
  composite("FORPOL", single_item("Foreign_Policy_salience")),
  composite("IMMIG",  single_item("Immigration_salience")),
  composite("SOCISS", single_item("Social_Issues_salience")),
  composite("VOTE",   single_item("republican_pct"))
)

models <- list()
```

## Structural models

```{r}
sm_all6 <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("DEMLAW", "DOMPOL", "ECON", "FORPOL", "IMMIG", "SOCISS"), to = "VOTE")
)

sm_5topics <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("DEMLAW", "ECON", "FORPOL", "IMMIG", "SOCISS"), to = "VOTE")
)

sm_4topics <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("DEMLAW", "FORPOL", "IMMIG", "SOCISS"), to = "VOTE")
)

sm_3topics <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("DEMLAW", "FORPOL", "IMMIG"), to = "VOTE")
)
```

## M1: Salience only, all 6 -\> VOTE

```{r}
est_m1 <- estimate_pls(data = df, measurement_model = mm_salience, structural_model = sm_all6)
set.seed(42)
boot_m1 <- bootstrap_model(est_m1, nboot = 5000)
print_paths(boot_m1)
plot(boot_m1, title = "M1: Macro salience, all 6 -> VOTE")
save_plot(boot_m1, "M1_macro_salience_all6", "M1: Macro salience, all 6 -> VOTE")
save_summary(boot_m1, est_m1, "M1_macro_salience_all6")
models[["M1_macro_salience_all6"]] <- list(label = "M1: Macro salience, all 6 -> VOTE",
                                           summary = summary(est_m1),
                                           report = file.path(report_dir, "M1_macro_salience_all6.txt"))
```

## M2: Salience only, 5 topics (DOMPOL dropped)

```{r}
est_m2 <- estimate_pls(data = df, measurement_model = mm_salience, structural_model = sm_5topics)
set.seed(42)
boot_m2 <- bootstrap_model(est_m2, nboot = 5000)
print_paths(boot_m2)

models[["M2_macro_salience_5topics"]] <- list(label = "M2: Macro salience, 5 topics -> VOTE",
                                              summary = summary(est_m2),
                                              report = file.path(report_dir, "M2_macro_salience_5topics.txt"))
```

## Model comparison

```{r}
comparison <- tibble(
  model = names(models),
  label = vapply(models, function(x) x$label, character(1)),
  vote_r2 = vapply(models, function(x) extract_vote_r2(x$summary), numeric(1)),
  report_file = vapply(models, function(x) x$report, character(1))
) %>%
  arrange(desc(vote_r2))

comparison
```
